value_stream.name: Customer Digital Engagement & Mobile App Operations

fields.Participants: Digital Analytics Manager, Marketing, CMO, CFO

workflows.name: Digital Channel Attribution & Customer Journey Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - Dashboard auto-refreshed from source systems; anomalies auto-flagged; report auto-distributed to stakeholders
Controls: - CTL-456 (ensure controlled execution — Digital Engagement Analytics & Optimization (PA-75.3).)
- CTL-456 (data-privacy — links to VS-91 / W53, RA 10173); Operational: Digital Analytics Manager sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Metric-gaming risk**: a metric is gamed (marking complete before actual completion, excluding unfavorable data); mitigated by the source-system ground truth and the cross-metric consistency check

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit
System Touchpoints: - Ecommerce/marketplace platform (links to VS-10 / W11 BOPIS, W180 marketplace integration)
- CRM (links to VS-13 / W17 loyalty, W156 CDP, W65 CSAT)
- Analytics/BI (links to VS-27 / W113 BI platform, W231 QBR dashboard)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Digital Analytics Manager role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: Digital Analytics Manager maps customer journey: web → app → in-store → BOPIS; tracks cross-channel attribution; builds unified customer view
Manager analyzes attribution: app-driven in-store sales, web-to-store conversion, digital promo redemption, notification influence on purchase
CFO reviews digital ROI: acquisition cost per channel, lifetime value per digital vs. non-digital customer, marketing spend effectiveness; adjusts investment allocation

fields.Participants: Digital Product Mgr, Marketing, Digital Analytics Manager

workflows.name: App User Acquisition & Retention Funnel Analysis

Automation Opportunity: - Self-service workflows (scan-and-go, product lookup, self-checkout) reducing staff intervention; feature-adoption auto-tracked from app telemetry
Controls: - CTL-456 (ensure controlled execution — Digital Engagement Analytics & Optimization (PA-75.3).)
- operational: Digital Product Manager sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Adoption-risk**: the digital feature launches but customers/staff don't adopt it, wasting the investment; mitigated by the user-testing and the adoption-incentive

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit
System Touchpoints: - Mobile app (links to VS-75 / digital engagement app, VS-10 / ecommerce)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Digital Product Manager role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: Product Manager analyzes acquisition funnel: impressions → downloads → registrations → first purchase → repeat; calculates CPI and CPA per channel
Manager analyzes retention: Day 1/7/30 rates; compares by source, segment, feature usage; identifies churn signals
steps.r: Digital Product Manager / Digital Analytics Manager

steps.activity: Marketing implements retention campaigns: re-engagement push, personalized recommendations, app-only offers, points acceleration; Product Manager measures impact

fields.Participants: IT Integration Mgr, Digital Product Manager, Ecommerce Manager

Automation Opportunity: - API-driven real-time sync (catalog, inventory, pricing, orders) eliminating manual data entry; auto-reconciliation of marketplace settlement vs. BuildRight records
Controls: - CTL-456 (ensure controlled execution — Digital Engagement Analytics & Optimization (PA-75.3).)
- operational: IT Integration Manager sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Integration-failure risk**: marketplace API sync fails (catalog, inventory, or order), causing overselling or customer-facing errors; mitigated by real-time sync monitoring and the failover to manual processing

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit
System Touchpoints: - Ecommerce/marketplace platform (links to VS-10 / W11 BOPIS, W180 marketplace integration)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the IT Integration Manager role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: IT Integration Manager monitors: POS-to-app inventory sync, price propagation, BOPIS transmission, fulfillment updates, loyalty sync; alerts for failures
Manager investigates incidents: root cause analysis, impact assessment; implements preventive measures (retry logic, circuit breakers)
Digital Product Manager reviews health monthly: uptime (99.5%), data freshness, error rates; identifies integrations needing improvement
steps.r: Digital Product Manager / IT Integration Manager
